text:
Alex: Ran a quick mini-benchmark for sirocco-lite-8.5B (int6) last night — dumping cost/latency/quality summary. curious if we should temporarily route long-doc traffic to int8.

Alex: Results (slice: long-doc QA vs short chat):
```
Model        | quant  | p50 lat(ms) | p95 lat(ms) | tokens/s | cost/unit | QA-EM
sirocco-lite | int6   | 95          | 420         | 12       | $0.006    | 0.74
sirocco-lite | int8   | 90          | 310         | 14       | $0.008    | 0.76
```

Maya: Interesting — int6 looks cheaper per-token but that p95 spike sucks for long-doc. Which slice drives the tail? :thinking:

Chao: The p95 is almost entirely from the long-doc QA slice where KV cache cold starts happen. We saw many requests with seq_len>1024.

Alex: Confirmed. Short chat and priming cases have normal tails (p95 ~120ms). Long-docs hit the backend KVC miss and then latency jumps.

Linh: Quality-wise the EM delta is tiny (0.74->0.76). Product might accept a 2-3% quality hit if cost savings are meaningful. Need unit-econ calc by slice.

ops-bot: Canary routing rule applied: route 20% of traffic tagged `long-doc-qa` -> sirocco-lite:int8.

Maya: Can we add a rule: if seq_len>1024 fallback to int8? Also add a p95-by-seq_len metric on Console per model+quant.

Chao: Quick experiment thought: enable KV prewarm for cached prefixes or warmstart the KV for top-200 prefixes. That should cut the cold-start cost for long-doc QA. Can we A/B for 24h?

Alex: I'll kick off a 24h prewarm run on staging. command to run: 
```
bench/run_econ.sh --model sirocco-lite --quant int6 --prewarm --slices long-doc-qa --duration 24h
```

Linh: Also will sketch a unit-econ scorecard: tokens/$, p95 target, and quality delta per slice. will post an initial CSV to the console.

Maya: If prewarm reduces p95 by >25% we can keep int6 as default. Otherwise recommend routing default long-doc QA to int8 until we optimize. :thumbsup:

Alex: noted. Running experiments now, will share results by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
